english.title: Fail to comply with a notice issued under section 83 of the Public Health Act
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[occupier]_
(C)_[owner and occupier]_

of premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), and having been given notice that the local authority, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..), were satisfied that those premises were

(D)_[in such a filthy or unwholesome condition as to be prejudicial to health,]_
(E)_[verminous,]_
(F)_[in such a filthy or unwholesome condition as to be prejudicial to health and were verminous,]_

failed to take the steps specified in the notice

(F)_[to remedy the condition of the premises by cleansing and disinfecting them,]_
(G)_[that were necessary for destroying or removing vermin]_
(H)_[to remedy the condition of the premises by cleansing and disinfecting them and that were necessary for the destruction or removal of vermin,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY STEPS IN NOTICE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 83 of the Public Health Act 1936.
